summary: Public Service Company of Colorado (PSCo) and Xcel Energy Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose the filing of a non-unanimous settlement in PSCo's pending Colorado natural gas rate case. The settlement provides for a $123 million revenue increase (7.5% total, 3.7% annual average), 9.2% ROE, and 54.5% equity ratio. A CPUC hearing is set for July 2026 with a decision expected in Q4 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing related to utility rate-setting, not a corporate special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or any other special-situations event is described.
